title: Tool
description: The declared contract of a versioned tool (ADR-0005 §2). Tools are data and are immutable per version. The agent runtime holds tool definitions only, never implementations, and cannot invoke a tool by any path other than the control-plane choke point.

schemaVersion.description: ADR-0024 §5: stored documents are versioned as data. One version exists in V1.

description.description: Model-facing. This text reaches the model, so it is platform-authored and never assembled from repository or issue content.

inputSchema.description: An embedded JSON Schema document that MUST itself be closed. ADR-0005 §2: anything not declared is rejected rather than ignored, so a model cannot smuggle undeclared fields past validation into an integration client. The requirement is expressed here by demanding the literal key 'additionalProperties': false in the embedded document.

scopeRequirements.description: Which scopes a grant must contain for this tool to be invocable.

idempotency.description: NATURAL: the external system deduplicates, or a natural key exists. KEYED: requires a platform-derived idempotency key. NONE: only permissible for READ.

approvalPolicy.description: ADR-0005 §2. IRREVERSIBLE tools always require approval regardless of this field; policy may strengthen the requirement but never weaken it.

predicate.description: Evaluated over validated tool input only, never over model prose.

then.description: ADR-0005 §3: EXTERNAL_WRITE and IRREVERSIBLE require an idempotency key. The platform must be able to run the same node twice and leave one branch, one pull request and one comment.
ADR-0005 §3: IRREVERSIBLE always requires human approval. Class is declared on the tool and is not negotiable per call.
